data.name: Fateha
data.gender_notes: Fateha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fateha is derived from the root word 'fatha' which means 'to open'. It is also a term used in Islamic tradition for the first chapter of the Quran, which is called 'Al-Fatiha'. The name symbolizes the opening of the heart to receive the blessings of Allah. The name Fateha carries the meaning “Opener, Opener of the heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fateha usually hope their child will grow to embody opener, opener of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Fateha is mentioned in a Hadith as a name that is loved by Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, 'There is a man in my nation whose name is Fateha, and Allah loves him.'
data.etymology: Fateha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opener, Opener of the heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fateha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
